title: Level cut-offs χ_h(f) converge to the indicator of {x ∈ U : f(x) < t}: dominated convergence as h → 0+ (parent Step 4)
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P, every f : ℝ^P → ℝ which is L-Lipschitz on U (L ≥ 0), every measure ν on ℝ^P, every ν-integrable F : ℝ^P → ℝ with F(x) = 0 for all x ∉ U, every t ∈ ℝ and every family χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ (h ↦ χ_h) such that for every h > 0 the function χ_h is Borel measurable, |χ_h(s)| ≤ 1 for all s, χ_h(s) = 1 for all s ≤ t − h and χ_h(s) = 0 for all s ≥ t: ∫ χ_h(f(x))·F(x) dν(x) → ∫_{{x ∈ U : f(x) < t}} F dν as h → 0+ (along the filter 𝓝[>] 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzOnWith L f U → ∀ (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (F : Eucl P → ℝ), Integrable F ν → (∀ x, x ∉ U → F x = 0) → ∀ (t : ℝ) (χ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → Measurable (χ h)) → (∀ h s : ℝ, 0 < h → |χ h s| ≤ 1) → (∀ h s : ℝ, 0 < h → s ≤ t - h → χ h s = 1) → (∀ h s : ℝ, 0 < h → t ≤ s → χ h s = 0) → Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => ∫ x, χ h (f x) * F x ∂ν) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ x in {x | x ∈ U ∧ f x < t}, F x ∂ν))
